observations: Photo 0 shows a stack of 12 PS5 game cases.
Each case has a white spine with 'PS5' logo and game title printed on it.

Games include: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade, Back 4 Blood, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, Demon's Souls, Marvel Spider-Man: Miles Morales, Watch Dogs Legion, Grand Theft Auto V, Assassin's Creed Valhalla, The Last of Us Part I, Planet Coaster, FC 26 (twice).
Cases appear to be standard PS5 physical game cases with blue plastic edges.
Some cases show minor scuffs or smudges, especially on the top few.
The background is a textured brown surface, possibly leather or faux leather.
No discs are visible — only the cases are shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used Discs of Playstation 5 available
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the cases, not the discs. The condition of the discs themselves is not visible. The term 'neatly used' cannot be verified without seeing the discs or their condition.
